notes: Original base gate plus hard strong agreement accepted mask is independently reconstructed and checked unchanged. Trusted correction never broadens original teacher confidence/physical-neighbor base eligibility.

Trust fixed before any source labels are counted: both ownEMA weak views confidence>=.99 and argmax agreement; secondweak GaussianRMS=.003. These views are correlated, not independent evidence or calibrated correctness.

New admissible correction requires student strong disagreement; rank by original teacher confidence, select at most floor(.1*original accepted count) and original strong pseudo-CE sum<=.25*original accepted CE sum per batch. No accepted originals means zero corrections; no forced fill or class quota.

All selected samples retain original uniform hard pseudo CE, mean over selected count; no soft targets, changed lambda_U=.16, threshold search or gradient reweighting. Maximum correction CE fraction is20% of merged U loss mass; count selection is not a new loss denominator.

This source V proxy uses fixedfinal50 models and reproduces teacher eval/student train Dropout strong views under no_grad, with unchanged state. It does not prove earlier online teacher reliability or hidden U precision.

Source summaries include original acceptance, reliable agreed, candidate and admitted subsets by RX/day/TX plus full64 co-rejection combinations. Analytic logits gradient is explicitly not actual ftheta update evidence.
If fixed reliability/count criteria fail, preserve negative result and do not enable B/D merely to fill a2x2. Thresholds/caps cannot be tuned from V or target results.
